general_summary: Private practice in Portugal since 1983. Before that, in Brazil since 1977. Long experience in residential design, both single- and multi-family buildings. A good know-how in designing for tropical climates and low-cost construction. Some experience also in small hotels and restaurants.

Architect, based at Porto (Portugal), worked between 2005 and 2006 in Porto Alegre , RS – Brazil, with emphasis on the 1st place in the national architectural competition for Tecnologic Center of the University of Caxias do Sul ( in partnership with the Ideia1 architectural office). Back in Portugal in 2007 founded the architecture, art and design office URBAstudios which has already developed housing projects, commercial, services and institutional projects. In addition to its own projects, the studio is available to develop ideas , collaborations and partnerships with artists, designers , architects and others in the development of projects, interventions and products. In 2015 co-founded the Openfield CreativeLab. Art+Tech Space of creation, research, development and presentation in all kind of media

The OPENLAB architects is a multidisciplinary laboratory for the development of ideas in the fields of architecture, interiors and design that offers support to its customers from the initial conception to the final execution of the projects. The practice got an award from World Architecture Awards, was published internationally and was invited for the conference cycle ‘Jovens arquitectos premiados internacionalmente’ a joint initiative of the Portuguese Architects Order and MUDE, the Lisbon based Museum of Design and Fashion.
